<!-- This code has been fully generated by an AI. -->

Builds Python source and wheel distributions with `python -m build` and uploads `dist/*` artifacts to PyPI (or TestPyPI / private indexes) using `twine upload`.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/publisher-pypi
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/publisher-pypi:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/publisher-pypi:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/publisher-pypi/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/updater-python
    phase: pre-tag
    args:
      file: pyproject.toml

  - uses: @semrel/publisher-pypi
    phase: release
    args:
      pypi_token: '${env.PYPI_API_TOKEN}'
      # Optional: target TestPyPI or a private index
      # pypi_repository_url: "https://test.pypi.org/legacy/"
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PYPI_TOKEN` | yes (unless dry-run) | `—` | PyPI API token passed as `TWINE_PASSWORD` (`__token__` username). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PYPI_REPOSITORY_URL` | no | PyPI default | Custom repository URL passed to `twine upload --repository-url` (e.g. `https://test.pypi.org/legacy/`). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_WORKDIR` | no | `.` | Project directory where `python -m build` and `dist/` are evaluated. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PYTHON_BIN` | no | `python` / `python3` | Override the Python executable name or path. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_TWINE_BIN` | no | `twine` | Override the `twine` executable name or path. |

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`

## Behavior

1. Detects `python` or `python3` on `$PATH`.
2. Runs `python -m build` in the configured working directory.
3. Collects artifacts in `dist/*`.
4. Uploads distributions via `twine upload` (or logs the planned artifacts without uploading when `SEMREL_DRY_RUN=true`).
